claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to change global auction settings.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to change global auction settings.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must be logged into the Auction Administration (AA) application.
The Auctioneer must have access to the 'Main Menu' page of the AA application.
The system must allow remote access via Virtual Private Network (VPN) if the user is accessing remotely.
The Auctioneer initiates the use case by selecting the option to change global auction settings from the Main Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer initiates the use case by selecting the option to change global auction settings from the Main Menu.

claims.content: The Auctioneer views the 'Auction Admin Main Menu Page'.
The system displays the 'Administration Menu Section' containing labels and links to administrative pages.
The Auctioneer selects the 'Manage Global Settings' link from the Administration Menu Section.

The global auction settings (including Reserve Tier & Bid Increment, Overtime Bidding, Shipping, Preview Period, and Post-Close Removals) are updated in the system according to the Auctioneer’s inputs.
Changes to global settings are saved only after the Auctioneer clicks 'Apply Changes' for each section.

Auction Event Profiles can be created or edited with customized Opening Bid, Bid Increment, Duration, and application rules (e.g., gemstones only, jewelry only, SKU prefix), and changes are saved upon clicking 'Apply'.
The low end of the next cost tier automatically populates as the high end of the previous range + $0.01.
Percentages of Cost values under 100% appear in BOLD RED in both Global Settings and Auction Event Profiles pages.
